content.short: Wave is a Telegram-integrated ecosystem on Sui featuring a GasLess wallet and AI trading tools for all users.
content.description: Wave is a pioneering decentralized ecosystem built natively on the high-performance Sui blockchain, designed to provide millions of users with a seamless gateway to Web3 through the Telegram messaging platform. The platform features the Wave Wallet, a self-custodial digital asset manager that utilizes an innovative "GasLess" protocol, allowing participants to interact with dApps and execute trades without holding native gas tokens. Wave also includes AI-enhanced trading tools and auto-sniping bots to provide users with a professional-grade trading experience on-chain.
content.meta: Wave provides a Telegram-integrated DeFi ecosystem on Sui with GasLess wallets. Discover Wave and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
